title: SaGE: Evaluating Moral Consistency in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper's benchmark, the Moral Consistency Corpus (MCC), measures the moral consistency of Large Language Models when presented with semantically equivalent questions. It does not specifically measure any aspects related to faith or religion; the moral scenarios presented are secular in nature.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith, as its focus is on general moral consistency in secular contexts.
